# Ian Leonard (Lenny) — lennymadethat.com

> Manufacturing operations leader and AI systems builder based in San Diego, California. Runs production operations day to day and designs and ships the AI agents, automation engines, and internal tools that run businesses. Designer by training, operator by trade.

## What he does
- Manufacturing & operations leadership: teams, throughput, cost, quality, and the systems that hold production together.
- AI systems & agent infrastructure: a custom knowledge base + MCP server his agents read and write, multi-agent automation, dashboards, and live web apps — built and deployed, not slideware.
- Tools: packaging the systems behind his work into downloadable distribution kits so others can run them (the Distribution Kit Foundry, in progress).

## The Foundry — builds shipped
- The Content Operative — AI content agent; ramble in, on-brand draft out; learns a voice fingerprint, runs voice + compliance checks, drafts to a newsletter platform, never auto-publishes. (Live)
- Vault Agent Fleet — a fleet of specialized AI agents that reads any dropped file (notes, PDFs, images, audio, video), classifies/tags/links/extracts, and files it into one searchable knowledge base; runs in the cloud on a schedule. (Live)
- The Harvester — YouTube URL + lens in; AI watches the video, synthesizes a structured briefing, routes action items to the right project. (Live)
- The Forge — visual workflow builder + generic execution engine; draw an automation as a graph, one interpreter runs any graph; self-hostable. (Shipped)
- PlayLetter — his own consumer product: turns the newsletters you subscribe to into a personal audio feed (natural AI voices, morning-show routines, offline listening, cross-device resume); native iOS + Android, live in both app stores with paying subscribers. (Live)
- Retail Investor Platform — live income-investing web app: screening, return simulator, fund-flow intelligence, AI research dossier, brokerage sync, member area. (Live)
- Yield Observatory — static dashboard of stablecoin/RWA yields with reliability scoring and AI-authored risk dossiers, on public data. (Shipped)
- Podcast Studio — browser recording studio; record audio/video, edit by editing the transcript, AI cover art, publish. (Live)
- Field Ops Console — operations console syncing live jobs, sites, and field devices into one app. (Live)
- Income Data API — paid API for programmatic/agent access to the income-ETF dataset; tiered keys, free tier, metered agent wall. (In build)
- The Vault System — markdown knowledge base + database + semantic search + a server any AI assistant reads/writes; the backbone the rest run on. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/lennymadethat/persistent-memory (Live)
- Mothership — self-hostable hub to reach a coding agent on your always-on home machine from any phone or browser; sessions survive across devices, token-gated, self-hosted. Open source (MIT): https://github.com/lennymadethat/mothership (Live)
- dev → live Starter Kit — the repo template behind every build: branch structure, deploy config, sanitization gate. (In build)

## Distribution Kit Foundry
Each build is being packaged into a downloadable distribution kit with setup instructions and licensing. Download buttons on lennymadethat.com surface kits as they ship; honest status (Live / Shipped / In build / Coming soon) is shown on every build.
